subject: Request: Residency & private-deploy attestation for Mediflow pilot
messages:
From: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@mediflow.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Request: Residency & private-deploy attestation for Mediflow pilot

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today — the demo was helpful. Mediflow is preparing an internal compliance package for a pilot integration and we need a short packet that confirms:  

- Primary hosting region for customer data and inference: EU (Ireland) availability and whether any control-plane metadata crosses regions.
- VPC/private-deploy connectivity options: Privatelink/Privatelnk-like endpoints, peering CIDR ranges, and expected egress patterns.
- Keystore/KMS model: are keys customer-managed (BYOK) or customer-segregated HSM; evidence of split-keystore architecture and any escrow options.
- Attestation artifacts: SOC 2 report summary, SIG Lite answers or CAIQ extract relevant to networking/crypto, and a short runbook for onboarding peering.

We can accept redacted artifacts. If you can share an excerpted CAIQ and a network map (even high level) that would be great. Timeline: we need the packet by EOD next Wednesday (2027-11-10) to make our compliance gate.  

A few clarifying items: do VPN/privatelink endpoints use dedicated regional egress? Will there be any cross-border telemetry we should plan for? Also, is there an MOU or simple one-page tech addendum we can sign before exchanging more sensitive artifacts?

Thanks,
Alice Jensen
Head of Security Programs
Mediflow

--
Alice Jensen
Mediflow — security@mediflow.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@mediflow.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 17:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Request: Residency & private-deploy attestation for Mediflow pilot

Hi Alice — great to meet you earlier. Appreciate the clear list. We can deliver a concise packet that addresses each bullet. High-level answers up front:  

- Region: Production inference nodes for the Mediflow pilot will be pinned to the eu-west-1 (Ireland) region. Control-plane metadata (billing/usage aggregates) is routed to Redwood's control plane in us-west-2 for analytics; no raw customer prompt/response data is transferred outside EU for pinned deployments. We will include a brief statement and diagram.

- Connectivity: We support private endpoint options (AWS PrivateLink / equivalent) and peering for Dedicated/Private customers. Expected peering ranges depend on customer CIDR but we will provide an example matrix and the expected egress pattern (regional NAT + optional egress through customer-managed transit).

- Keystore: For Private deployments customers can use a customer-managed KMS/HSM; for Dedicated we support tenant-key partitioning with split-keystore where customer key material is isolated. We do offer an escrow path for legal-only key recovery in exceptional cases — will document controls.

Action plan and artifacts we will provide by 2027-11-10 (per your ask):  
1) CAIQ excerpt focusing on Networking, Cryptography, and Key Management (redacted where necessary) — attached as redwood_CAIQ_excerpt_2027.pdf.
2) High-level private endpoint / peering map (privatelink_network_map_v2.png) and an onboarding checklist.
3) Keystore architecture diagram (keystore_split_diagram.svg) + short runbook notes.
4) A one-page technical addendum / MOU template we can sign — I’ll send the DocuSign link.

I’m including Kimberly (LegalOps) for the MOU and Grace (Ops) for the network/keystore diagrams. If you have a preferred compliance contact or a safe inbox for redacted artifacts please share it.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

- Deliverables: CAIQ excerpt (network/crypto/KMS), privatelink map, keystore split diagram, onboarding runbook, and a one-page tech addendum (DocuSign).
- Kimberley: please prepare the MOU template and confirm if Legal wants the DocuSign envelope to include the CAIQ excerpt NDAs or if we should gate artifacts until the MOU is signed. Suggest a light NDA clause + tech addendum for pilot. HubSpot deal is HS-87321.
- Grace: can you produce the privatelink map with CIDR example, and the keystore SVG showing tenant key partitioning + escrow flow? Include a short bulleted runbook for peering steps (BGP/ACLs/expected timings).

Timebox: Mediflow wants everything by EOD Wed 2027-11-10. If Legal needs more time flag it — we can propose a partial deliverable (network map + CAIQ excerpt) to hit their gate.
